command_ordering: Every ordinary accepted LLD-02 command follows LLD-01 ordering: idempotency check -> load/revalidate -> allocate immutable IDs -> insert command_receipt -> domain/lifecycle writes -> audit -> commit. Any later failure rolls the receipt back with the command.

commands.name: CreateCustomerOrganization
steps: compute name_match_key and optional account-code match_key
when account code supplied, detect any active different claimant and return ACCOUNT_CODE_CONFLICT_REVIEW with no mutation
allocate customer_org_id, optional identifier_id and lifecycle_event_id
insert optional active customer_account_code identifier referencing receipt
append created lifecycle event referencing receipt
rules: matching candidates may be shown before command but equal name never blocks creation solely as identity duplication
Customer Account Code is preferred external matching evidence but never the relational ID
reviewed duplicate-code preservation uses ConfirmCustomerAccountCodeSharedClaim after Customer creation; ordinary create does not silently create a multiply claimed code
no implicit merge/adoption

commands.name: SetCustomerAccountCode
steps: load active Customer by immutable ID and revalidate revision
query all active canonical claimants for exact normalized code
if any other Customer claims the code return ACCOUNT_CODE_CONFLICT_REVIEW with bounded claimant identities and no mutation
supersede this Customer's prior active account-code row when different
insert new active claim when not already the same accepted value
increment Customer revision when canonical claim changes
insert audit referencing superseded/new identifier identities
rules: prior claims remain history
same already-active code under same Customer is idempotent only through normal command-receipt semantics
source/import observations never call this without reviewed acceptance

commands.name: ConfirmCustomerAccountCodeSharedClaim
commands.purpose: explicit reviewed acceptance that one normalized Customer Account Code currently has more than one canonical Customer Organization claimant
steps: require nonempty reviewed conflict context and active target Customer
normalize exact code and load bounded identities/count of existing active claimants
require at least one different active claimant or reject as wrong command path
supersede target Customer's different active account-code claim when present
insert active shared claim for target Customer without mutating other claimants
insert audit carrying review_context_id and every affected local identifier identity plus bounded existing-claimant summary
rules: does not merge Customers
does not silently choose a winner
future account-code matching remains AMBIGUOUS while multiple active claimants remain
other claimant records/history are untouched
this command is unavailable to safe auto-accept paths

commands.name: ReassignCustomerAccountCode
commands.purpose: explicit reviewed resolution moving one active account-code claim from one Customer Organization to another
steps: require distinct immutable Customer IDs and active targets
normalize exact code and prove from-Customer has an active claim for that code
supersede any different active account-code claim on to-Customer
insert active code claim for to-Customer
insert one reasoned audit action referencing changed identifier/Customer identities and review_context_id
rules: does not merge Customer Organizations
does not rewrite historical operational Customer context
does not silently supersede any third Customer that also has the same reviewed active claim; such remaining claimants keep the code ambiguous
cannot be triggered merely by equal display names
failure anywhere rolls all claim/revision/audit changes back

commands.name: CreateContact
steps: validate referenced active Customer if supplied
allocate contact_id plus optional channel/affiliation/lifecycle IDs
insert optional current affiliation referencing receipt
append created lifecycle event referencing receipt
rules: zero affiliation is valid
equal name/email candidate evidence never silently selects an existing Contact
initial affiliation preserves Contact identity independence

commands.name: UpdateContactDescriptiveData
steps: append descriptive_corrected lifecycle event when material identity-facing descriptive data changes
rules: does not change contact_id or affiliation
channel removal/archive cannot erase historical operational snapshots owned elsewhere

commands.name: ChangeContactAffiliation
steps: load active Contact and current affiliation
validate new Customer is active when non-null
resolve idempotent replay through receipt lookup before mutation
allocate new affiliation ID when needed
close current affiliation row when present using accepted occurrence time
insert new current affiliation row when non-null referencing receipt
rules: same Contact identity is retained
historical affiliation rows are never rewritten to current
name equality cannot authorize this command
operational records preserve their own organization-at-use context

commands.name: CreateStandaloneDispatchLocation
steps: append created lifecycle event referencing receipt
rules: no Customer ownership/preference relationship is created
operation role is not written to the master

commands.name: CreateDedicatedDispatchLocationForSite
commands.visibility: cross-domain service used by LLD-08 coordinator, not standalone public commit
steps: require caller has completed idempotency/revalidation and inserted the shared command_receipt in this UnitOfWork
insert active address_mode site_derived with null standalone address
append created lifecycle event referencing shared receipt
return identity/event to LLD-08 coordinator which inserts the one-to-one Site relation and final audit/result references before shared commit
commands.rule: failure of Site/relation/audit creation rolls back Dispatch Location, lifecycle event and receipt in the same UnitOfWork

commands.name: UpdateReferenceDescriptiveData
steps: validate fields and recompute matching keys
rules: cannot change immutable ID
Customer Account Code is changed only through its dedicated governed commands and not through generic descriptive update
Dispatch Location cannot change customer ownership because no such field exists
site_derived address cannot be overwritten here; Site address is owned by LLD-08

commands.name: ArchiveReference
commands.ordering: archive algorithm uses bounded guard checks inside the write UnitOfWork and inserts receipt only after every guard passes

commands.name: ReactivateReference
commands.ordering: reactivation algorithm uses bounded guard checks inside the write UnitOfWork and inserts receipt only after every guard passes

commands.name: WriteSetting
steps: serialize/strictly validate named/versioned JSON through LLD-01
INSERT new row or UPDATE existing row explicitly with next revision; SQL REPLACE is forbidden
rules: no write occurs merely because a default exists
unknown setting key is rejected
secret-classified settings are rejected from this store and routed to LLD-12-owned storage

commands.name: CreateLocalUserProfileIdentity
input: existing UnitOfWork from LLD-12 setup coordinator
steps: require caller's shared setup command ordering/idempotency contract
commands.rule: LLD-12 owns verifier/auto-login creation and the coordinator commits metadata+required authentication state atomically or rolls all back
